blind.description: A stone rotunda or classical gazebo featuring a circular stepped stone plinth base, five cylindrical classical columns with square bases and simple capitals, a circular stone entablature/ring, and a domed verdigris/oxidized copper roof topped with a central spherical finial and five radial ribs.
blind.from_above: A circular domed roof with a spherical finial at the center, five green copper ribs radiating outwards dividing five curved roof panels, encircled by a stone cornice rim and a lower concentric circular stone base.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: circular stepped stone plinth that forms the integrated base of the gazebo
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.3 to 1.4 times the height of the figure (roughly 7.5 to 8 feet tall) and about 1.5 times as wide across the base.
